name: Building and using learned world models
gist: Training agents to learn a model of how the world works, then using that model to plan actions or simulate outcomes without constantly trying things in the real world.
explain: A world model is a learned simulation of how things work. Show it an image and current speed, and it predicts the next image. Show it a robotic arm's joint angles and the force it applies, it predicts where the arm moves. If the learner can build an accurate model of the world, it doesn't have to try every action in the real world — it can try thousands of actions in simulation first, then run only the promising ones for real. This matters because simulation is fast and failures are free (virtual objects don't break), so it saves time and prevents real-world damage.

Building accurate models is hard because the world is complex and high-dimensional. A video frame is thousands of pixels, and predicting how they change requires understanding physics, lighting, occlusion, and rare events. Early predictions are usually blurry and wrong, which wastes time in simulation because the agent trains on a false world. The learner improves the model with each new observation by adjusting its predictions to match what actually happened, so accuracy grows over time when the agent actively explores and collects new experience to fix errors. The trick is balancing two goals: improve the model fast enough that simulation predictions are accurate enough to be useful (so the agent doesn't waste time practicing skills that won't work in reality), but also don't get trapped in a loop where the model's systematic errors consistently teach the agent bad actions that fail when transferred to the real world (because the agent learned to do well in a false simulation). Papers here tackle model learning, planning strategies that work even with imperfect models, and deciding when to go back to real-world trials to fix model errors.

World models let reinforcement learning scale to tasks that would be too expensive to learn from scratch in the real world, which means researchers can tackle harder problems. A robot can learn reaching in simulation before touching physical objects. A game agent can plan millions of move-ahead sequences without playing millions of games.

papers.title: ADM-v2: Pursuing Full-Horizon Roll-out in Dynamics Models for Offline Policy Learning and Evaluation
papers.contribution: ADM-v2 achieves SOTA on both D4RL and NeoRL under full-horizon roll-out setting, with substantial advancements for policy optimization while other models degrade.

papers.title: Ada-Diffuser: Latent-Aware Adaptive Diffusion for Decision-Making
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness in accurate latent inference, long-horizon planning, and adaptive policy learning on locomotion and robotic manipulation benchmarks.

papers.title: Adaptive Quasimetric Mapping : Principled Topological Abstraction for Robust Offline Goal-Conditioned Navigation
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance while requiring up to 100× fewer keypoints than prior approaches.

papers.title: Contractive Diffusion Policies: Robust Action Diffusion via Contractive Score-Based Sampling with Differential Equations
papers.contribution: CDPs consistently outperform baseline policies with pronounced benefits under data scarcity in both simulation and real-world offline learning settings.

papers.title: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models
papers.contribution: DiLA achieves superior results in video generation quality, action transfer, visual planning, and manifold interpretability while maintaining semantic action abstraction.

papers.title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Guiding World Models with Non-Curated Data
papers.contribution: Achieves 102.8% relative improvement in aggregate score across 72 visuomotor tasks on limited sample budgets; outperforms prior offline RL methods on manipulation and locomotion.

papers.title: From Observations to Events: Event-Aware World Models for Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: EAWM consistently boosts MBRL baseline performance by 10-45%, setting new state-of-the-art results on Atari 100K, Craftax 1M, and multiple DeepMind Control benchmarks.

papers.title: Learning Dynamics Feature Representation via Policy Attention for Dynamic Path Planning in Urban Road Networks
papers.contribution: Guarantees state completeness while significantly improving path planning performance and convergence speed compared to classical baselines.

papers.title: Mixture-of-World Models: Scaling Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Modular Latent Dynamics
papers.contribution: On Atari 100k, a single MoW agent achieves 110.4% mean human-normalized score (competitive with 26-task ensemble STORM) while using 50% fewer parameters; on Meta-World reaches 74.5% success.

papers.title: One Model for All Tasks: Leveraging Efficient World Models in Multi-Task Planning
papers.contribution: Achieves performance comparable to specialized single-task agents using one model with online RL at 71.5% of typical capacity across Atari, DMC, and Jericho benchmarks.

papers.title: TaskLoom: Weaving Knowledge Across Tasks in World Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms baseline methods on Proprio Control, Visual Control, and Meta-World benchmarks, validating hierarchical knowledge-sharing effectiveness for both low and high-dimensional inputs.

papers.title: Bayes Adaptive Monte Carlo Tree Search for Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: RL plus search framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art offline RL methods on D4RL MuJoCo tasks and stochastic tokamak control.

papers.title: Behavior-Invariant Task Representation Learning with Transformer-based World Models for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches with superior stability and generalization under out-of-distribution and sparse-reward settings.

papers.title: Boosting World Models Learning via Latent-Space Value Alignment
papers.contribution: Consistently boosts existing methods on Atari 100k and DeepMind Control with minimal code overhead; provides unified framework with negligible computational cost.

papers.title: Breaking the Computational Barrier: Provably Efficient Actor–Critic for Low-Rank MDPs
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing sample complexity guarantees for low-rank MDPs while being computationally tractable; extends to approximately low-rank MDPs and validates on standard Gym benchmarks.

papers.title: Co-Evolving Latent Action World Models
papers.contribution: CoLA-World matches or outperforms two-stage methods in video simulation quality and downstream visual planning while establishing a more robust and efficient paradigm.

papers.title: Compositional Planning with Jumpy World Models
papers.contribution: Compositional planning significantly improves zero-shot performance on challenging manipulation and navigation tasks, yielding 200% relative improvement on average over planning with primitive actions.

papers.title: Deep SPI: Safe Policy Improvement via World Models
papers.contribution: On ALE-57 benchmark, DeepSPI matches or exceeds strong baselines including PPO and DeepMDPs while retaining theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: Distributional Active Inference

papers.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination

papers.title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models with OCL Search
papers.contribution: Outperforms neurosymbolic and classical baselines in computational efficiency and solution quality across combinatorial planning domains.

papers.title: Episodic Memory-Guided Controllable Experience Synthesis for Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Exploratory Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: How Does the Lagrangian Guide Safe Reinforcement Learning through Diffusion Models?
papers.contribution: Theoretically grounded and empirically effective approach achieving strong and stable performance across diverse environments.

papers.title: Identifiable Token Correspondence for World Models

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Planners by Self-Supervised Action Gating with Energies
papers.contribution: Improves performance and robustness of diffusion planners across locomotion, navigation, and manipulation benchmarks without environment rollouts or policy retraining.

papers.title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies
papers.contribution: LP-DS improves sample efficiency and success across RoboMimic, OpenAI Gym, and Adroit with up to 25% return improvements, validated on real Franka deployment.

papers.title: Langevin Rollout Optimization for Modelic Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: BOOM-L consistently outperforms strong baselines on DeepMind Control Suite and Humanoid Bench in both sample efficiency and final performance.

papers.title: Laplacian Representations for Decision-Time Planning

papers.title: Latent Representation Alignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: LAVL achieves highest performance on 20 out of 22 OGBench datasets and exhibits strong performance on long-horizon and trajectory stitching tasks.

papers.title: Learning Disentangled Multi-Agent World Model for Decentralized Control
papers.contribution: Outperforms model-based and model-free baselines in convergence speed and final performance on multi-agent tasks, with visualizations confirming effective agent-interaction capture.

papers.title: Learning Massively Multitask World Models for Continuous Control
papers.contribution: Achieves better multitask performance and data-efficiency than baselines with strong open-loop control and rapid adaptation to unseen tasks.

papers.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Abstractions for Hierarchical Combinatorial Planning
papers.contribution: Outperforms strong baselines on challenging SSCO benchmarks through adaptive temporal abstraction and context-aware resource allocation.

papers.title: Learning Reward–Cost Balance in Safe RL via Score-Based World Models
papers.contribution: Achieves strong returns while substantially reducing safety violations across diverse benchmarks, demonstrating stable and interpretable safety-performance trade-offs.

papers.title: Learning Task-Sufficient World Models by Synergizing Agentic Exploration and Structured Modeling
papers.contribution: Recovers task-sufficient latent representations capturing all control-relevant factors, achieving improved sample efficiency and generalization across skills and tasks.

papers.title: Learning to Be Uncertain: Pre-training World Models with Horizon-Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on MetaWorld, DeepMind Control Suite, and RoboDesk by learning reliable temporal confidence in latent dynamics.

papers.title: Learning to Search and Searching to Learn for Generalization in Planning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization: heuristics trained on <30-block Blocksworld instances solve 488-block instances without search.

papers.title: Long-Horizon Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning Without Explicit Conservatism
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance on D4RL and NeoRL benchmarks, reaching state-of-the-art on 7 datasets with rollout horizons of several hundred steps without explicit conservatism.

papers.contribution: Achieves 1.67x average speedup over DreamerV3 on DMC, reaching 8.8x on sparse-reward tasks.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms competitive baselines on 100 OGBench tasks, particularly on highly suboptimal datasets requiring long-horizon reasoning.

papers.title: Olaf-World: Orienting Latent Actions for Video World Modeling
papers.contribution: We learn structured latent action spaces with stronger zero-shot transfer and data-efficient adaptation to new control interfaces over state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: One-Step Flow Q-Learning: Addressing the Diffusion Policy Bottleneck in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art D4RL performance with single-step action generation, substantially faster computation, and outperforms multi-step DQL.

papers.title: Parallel Stochastic Gradient-Based Planning for World Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms cross-entropy method and vanilla gradient-based optimization on long-horizon video-based world model tasks in success rate and convergence time.

papers.title: Policy-Driven World Model Adaptation for Robust Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on twelve noisy D4RL MuJoCo tasks and three stochastic Tokamak Control tasks with theoretical analysis supporting the design.

papers.title: Prioritized Model Experience Replay
papers.contribution: Improves stability, faster convergence, and higher sample efficiency on MuJoCo benchmarks based on finite-horizon performance analysis decomposing policy gaps.

papers.title: R2-Dreamer: Redundancy-Reduced World Models without Decoders or Augmentation
papers.contribution: Competitive with DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2 while training 1.59x faster, with substantial gains on DMC-Subtle tasks.

papers.title: RAD: Retrieval High-quality Demonstrations to Enhance Decision-making
papers.contribution: RAD achieves competitive or superior performance compared to baselines across diverse benchmarks, improving offline RL policy generalization.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Discrete Diffusion Policies for Combinatorial Action Spaces

papers.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Direct Group Preference Optimization

papers.title: RiskZero: Plan More to Risk Less with a Learned Model

papers.title: RulePlanner: All-in-One Reinforcement Learner for Unifying Design Rules in 3D Floorplanning
papers.contribution: The framework is extensible to new design rules and demonstrates transferability to unseen circuits.

papers.title: SOLAR for Offline MARL: Plateau-Triggered Potential Shaping under World-Model Uncertainty
papers.contribution: Provides theoretical analysis on policy invariance and plateau decision deviation; consistent gains in stability and final performance across sparse-reward offline MARL benchmarks with varying dataset quality.

papers.contribution: State-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks by focusing on bias correction rather than accuracy improvement.

papers.contribution: Couples wall-clock efficiency of large-scale simulation during pretraining with sample efficiency of model-based learning during finetuning, enabling zero-shot deployment and efficient adaptation on humanoids.

papers.title: Trust-Region Diffusion Policies for Massively Parallel On-Policy RL

papers.title: WIMLE: Uncertainty‑Aware World Models with IMLE for Sample‑Efficient Continuous Control

papers.title: WorldCompass: Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon World Models
